name: Client Decrypt
description: Requester-side decrypt of a protected module artifact from its SDS $LGR module-delivery grant (typed contracts 1.0: every port one SDS FlatBuffer type, no JSON and no hostcalls). The grant's wrapped content key (ENC header + payload, X25519 or secp256k1 unified ECIES, HKDF-SHA256, AES-256-CTR field encryption; a REC-wrapped $KMF payload) is unwrapped with the recipient's private key, which arrives on the recipient_key port as a $KMF (ROLE DecryptKey, KEY_BYTES the 32-byte private key). The protected bundle (AES-256-GCM, or a protected publication with its $REC trailer) is the protected_content $FIL CONTENT: fetching it (the grant's MODULE_DESCRIPTOR.WASM_CID over ipfs) is the host's. The plaintext is answered as $FIL CONTENT. Nothing is stored or published.

methods.description: grant_response $LGR + recipient_key $KMF + protected_content $FIL -> plaintext $FIL. A grant that is not Granted or lacks its descriptor, CID or wrapped key, a key that does not unwrap it, or a bundle that does not authenticate fails (decrypt-failed); a missing frame is missing-input.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The SDS $LGR module-delivery grant (MESSAGE_TYPE Granted) naming the module (MODULE_DESCRIPTOR.WASM_CID) and carrying its wrapped content key.

inputPorts.description: The SDS $LGR module-delivery grant (MESSAGE_TYPE Granted) naming the module (MODULE_DESCRIPTOR.WASM_CID) and carrying its wrapped content key.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The recipient's private key as a $KMF: ROLE DecryptKey, KEY_BYTES the 32-byte X25519 or secp256k1 private key the grant was wrapped to.

inputPorts.description: The recipient's private key as a $KMF: ROLE DecryptKey, KEY_BYTES the 32-byte X25519 or secp256k1 private key the grant was wrapped to.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The encrypted bundle (the bytes the grant's MODULE_DESCRIPTOR.WASM_CID names, fetched by the host) as a $FIL with CONTENT.

inputPorts.description: The encrypted bundle (the bytes the grant's MODULE_DESCRIPTOR.WASM_CID names, fetched by the host) as a $FIL with CONTENT.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The decrypted artifact as a $FIL (KIND File, SIZE, CONTENT).

outputPorts.description: The decrypted artifact as a $FIL (KIND File, SIZE, CONTENT).

sequentialJustification.detail: One grant is unwrapped and one bundle decrypted on the calling thread; the module creates no threads.
